The comparison sample also includes schools in the top 50 of QS, THE, or U.S. News, including ties. Each comparison uses its own top 100 and normalizes to Wharton. Publication coverage varies by school. Schools with no recorded articles receive zero Top-3 weight. PhD origins are unrestricted. The contribution from self placements is capped at one-quarter of the total. Across displayed records, 3497 complete PhD records are supplied as verified among 4699 submitted faculty.

policies.rank_bands: Use band midpoint as x and set rank_is_estimated to true.
policies.score_bands: Use band midpoint before normalization and set score_is_estimated to true.
policies.score_anchors: Use the rank-1 score and rank-100 score. When ties skip rank 100, use the 100th school in rank order.
policies.missing_scores: Ignore up to two missing sources; impute zero for each additional missing source. Divide the sum by max(available source count, total source count - 2). If none are available, publish zero.
policies.negative_scores: Preserve negative values below the rank-100 score; do not clamp.
policies.unranked_schools: Use the same missing-source rule for unranked schools: ignore up to two gaps, then impute zero.
policies.school_identity: Resolve every input name through school_name_dictionary.json; unmapped names fail the import.
policies.duplicate_school_in_source: Use the better-ranked record once; never sum overlapping affiliation totals.
policies.source_count: Number of available scores for score weighted; number of ranked sources for ranking weighted.
policies.confidentiality: Original ranks, source scores, raw rows, and source snapshots are excluded.

ranking_options.label: Top-3s/year at destination
ranking_options.formula: Sum graduates' destination-school Top 3 articles per year from the publication catalog. Cap the self-placement contribution at one-third of the external contribution.

legacy_import_metadata.description: Retained import-stage transforms only; not the current program or alternative-source scoring formulas.
legacy_import_metadata.active_policy: program_ranking_metadata; destination_inputs contains the final Top-3 destination weights.

school_model.parent_school_id: Null for an institution; otherwise the parent unit's school_id.
school_model.aliases: Names identifying the exact program unit, such as HBS. Used at the program stage.
school_model.display_order: Order among siblings within the same parent.

policies.scoring_stage: Count distinct recorded Top 3 finance journal articles by current verified finance faculty at each university. Divide by the publication-window length and sum destination scores across graduates.
policies.input_scores: One observed selected appointment per graduate, using the agreed combined destination-score options.
policies.program_membership: Use completed PhD roles. Include the faculty member in the exact unit and each ancestor, once per unit.
policies.university_result: Sum destination weights; cap self-placement score at external score / 3, hence one-quarter of the total.
policies.subschool_result: Sum that unit’s graduates in the same unscaled articles-per-year units. Include each graduate once in university totals.
policies.missing_scores: Destinations with no recorded articles receive zero Top-3 weight. Collection coverage varies by school. Supplemental comparisons use the retained sources and their own cutoffs.
policies.display: Keep universities above 0.25 on the 2015+ Top-3 total. For every sort column, show at most 100 universities ranked within that metric’s top 100; select results using the active metric, then apply the display cap. Attach the configured doctoral subunits below their parent, in lighter text.
policies.unknown_unit: Keep a university-only affiliation at the university level; do not guess a subschool.
policies.joint_doctorates: A joint doctorate is one PhD role with origin_affiliations whose credit_weight values sum to one. Split placement contributions equally among the documented partner institutions. Count the faculty member once in overall graduate totals.
policies.cohorts: Default to graduates from 2015 onward (inclusive). Main scores and alternative rankings show 2015+, 2005+, and All. All includes sourced undated doctoral records with an identified, unambiguous institution, including records marked uncertain. Dated uncertain PhDs and explicitly ambiguous institutions remain excluded. Preserve supplied verification labels.
policies.subscore_display: For university rows, rank each selected-window source placement total across the selected origin universe. Display #1 through #100, then - for ranks above 100. Suppress all alternative rankings when the university has fewer than three total tracked graduates across all years, regardless of source or selected period. Subunit subscore cells are blank. Top-3 score columns retain numeric totals.
policies.appointments: For scoring, require a verified current finance-department or university-finance-institute job. Exclude visiting, postdoctoral, teaching-only, courtesy, emeritus, honorary, practice, explicitly non-primary, actuarial-science, future, and ended roles from credit. Select the highest Top-3 score among simultaneous qualifying jobs, once per graduate. Keep historical, unverified, non-finance, and outside-sample listings visible with zero points.
policies.separate_doctorates: Keep separate completed doctorate records and credit only the latest award, using its institution and graduation year. Do not split credit between separate degrees. Unknown ordering or unresolved latest-award ties remain for review. Genuine documented joint awards retain their split-credit treatment.
policies.finance_unit_scope: Require an appointment in a finance department or university finance institute. A documented university finance research center qualifies as a finance institute. Research interests or SFI network membership alone are insufficient. Preserve known outside-unit appointments as data but exclude them from placement scoring and qualifying headcounts.
policies.unscored_placements: Show listed outside-sample and non-finance university jobs, historical placements, and unverified affiliations in normal type with zero Top-3 and alternative-ranking points. Prefer a verified current appointment; label past jobs as past, with unverified added when current whereabouts remain unresolved.

collection_sample.policy: Collect current finance faculty at universities with linked publication catalog records or in the top 50 of QS, THE, or U.S. News, including ties. PhD origins are unrestricted.

normalization.label: Wharton
normalization.policy: Top-3 scores are unscaled articles per year. Alternative comparison scores divide by Wharton in the same source.
normalization.formula: distinct recorded Top 3 articles by current finance faculty / years in the publication window

self_placements.policy: Self placements contribute at most one-quarter of the total score. Apply a proportional cap of external score / 3 within each university and cohort. Source comparisons and subunits inherit this factor; counts are unchanged.

composite_policy.article_count_basis: Count each published article once per university if a linked author is current verified finance faculty there. Attribute output to the current roster; the publication may predate the appointment.

source_comparisons.policy: Sum placement contributions using each source’s own top 100, including ties. Divide raw scores by Wharton’s score. Outside-source-top-100 destinations contribute zero. Inherit the Top-3 total’s proportional self-placement adjustment.

destination_faculty_size_adjustment.policy: No faculty-size adjustment in the articles-per-year draft.

minimum_cell_size.suppression_text: Censored due to minimum cell size suppression

graduation_cohorts.boundary: Inclusive PhD graduation year through the snapshot year; All also includes qualifying undated awards.

current_appointment_validation.policy: Current and best modes award points only for a verified current eligible finance-unit appointment at a scored destination. First mode awards points for the first qualifying dated faculty appointment only when its start year is supported, the role is verified as first (or employment history is complete), its finance unit and appointment are eligible, the destination is in sample, and the doctorate is otherwise eligible. Historical roles selected by current or best mode, unverified or ineligible roles, and outside-sample destinations receive zero points. Existing doctoral evidence and unknown-year policies are unchanged.

destination_sample.tie_policy: Include institutions ranked 50 or better in at least one source, including ties. Also include universities with linked catalog records.
